_about: Checked by hand against the printed book (A Dictionary of Color Combinations Vol. 2, Seigensha), November 2026. The raw answers were in tmp/vol2-to-fill.md.

checked.order: The first and last combination of each month have the same number and colour order as the 1934–35 cards (extracted.json); the book prints the colours at equal size.
checked.shared_cmyk: No. 1's colours have the same CMYK as in our Volume 1 data (Seashell Pink, White, Sulphur Yellow, Glaucous Green; Grayish Lavender is A).
checked.variants: Grayish Lavender and Eugenia Red: the book's colour index lists only A's values, so A everywhere (corrections.json "variant"). Except No. 16, which has both under the same name, in the book too: the 4th is B (25 33 20 0), the 6th A (28 28 0 0).
checked.spelling: The book prints Vandar Poel's Blue (and Volume 1 Cerulian, Antwarp, Rosolanc): misspellings of Ridgway's names, fixed in our colors.json, which keeps the printed spelling as bookName. The book prints Deep Violet / Plumbeous (ours: Deep Violet/Plumbeous).

Cerulean Blue.why: the book gives 84 26 32 0, our colour misspelled Cerulian Blue in Volume 1 (now fixed)

Light Green.why: card 34 prints Light Green; the book has Night Green, 52 0 100 0, as ours

Tawny Olive.why: card 32 prints Tawny Olive; the book has Khaki there, and the chip matches Khaki on cards 9 and 12

_new_about: Colours not in Volume 1, with the CMYK printed in the book; cards: [card number, position from the first colour].

notes.Pale Methyl Blue: the book prints "Pale Methy Blue"; the cards and Ridgway have Methyl, which we use
